info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Rooms Inventorys-v3-spec
info.description: The Hotel Rooms Inventory API provides essential access to the current inventory of available hotel rooms. This API allows consumers to retrieve a comprehensive list of rooms, including details like availability, pricing, and room specifications. It is designed for use by hotel management systems, booking platforms, and travel agencies seeking to integrate room availability data into their applications. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their booking processes and provide updated information to end users.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a detailed list of all available rooms in the inventory. You can use this information for booking, management, and inventory tracking purposes.
